**Proposed mechanism:** TERC (HGNC:11727) —DISRUPTS→ Telomere Maintenance (GO:0035264); Telomere Maintenance (GO:0035264) —LEADS_TO→ Short Telomeres (HP:0030170); Short Telomeres (HP:0030170) —LEADS_TO→ Bone Marrow Failure (HP:00114145); Bone Marrow Failure (HP:00114145) —LEADS_TO→ Dyskeratosis Congenita (HP:0001119).
